name: ArchiAR
description: Browser-based 3D and marker-AR preview for GLB/GLTF models. Compose a shareable preview URL for any CORS-enabled model.

actions.name: preview_model
actions.description: Open a GLB/GLTF model in a browser-based 3D/AR previewer.

model_url.description: Absolute https URL of a GLB or GLTF file with permissive CORS.

mode.description: Start mode. 'ar' requests webcam marker-AR; '3d' is the default drag-to-rotate preview.

actions.returns: An HTML page that renders the model. No API response body; interactive viewer only.

capabilities.privacy: No tracking. Camera stream stays on-device.
